Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject in need thereof, wherein said administration is provided in a manner that also considers the underlying factors contributing to glaucoma.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered to a subject in need thereof, wherein said administration is tailored to manage the factors that may lead to ocular hypertension.
